subject: Maths
title: Calculations in standard form
subtitle: Indices and Standard Form · GCSE Maths
learning_objective: I can add, subtract, multiply and divide numbers in standard form.

key_vocab.definition: Standard form is written as A × 10n where 1 ≤ A multiply or divide, use index laws on the powers of 10.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can add, subtract, multiply and divide numbers in standard form.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: Standard form -- Standard form is written as A × 10n where 1 ≤ A multiply or divide, use index laws on the powers of 10.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Multiply/divide: deal with A and 10^n separately. Add/subtract: match the powers of 10 first.
(a × 10m) × (b × 10n) = ab × 10m+n
Multiply A values, add indices

Key examples:
  ✓ (3 × 10²) × (2 × 10³) = 6 × 105  (multiply A values, add powers)
  ✓ (8 × 106) ÷ (4 × 10²) = 2 × 104  (divide A values, subtract powers)
  ✓ (4 × 10³) + (3 × 10³) = 7 × 10³  (same power, add A values)
  ✗ (3 × 10²) × (2 × 10³) = 6 × 106  (powers add, not multiply)
  ✗ (4 × 10³) + (3 × 10²) = 7 × 10³  (must match powers first)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – multiplication
  Calculate (4 × 10³) × (2 × 105)
  Multiply A values: 4 × 2 = 8
  Add powers: 3 + 5 = 8
  Answer: 8 × 108
  8 × 108
  (Multiply the numbers, add the indices.)

Example 2 – division
  Calculate (9 × 107) ÷ (3 × 10³)
  Divide A values: 9 ÷ 3 = 3
  Subtract powers: 7 − 3 = 4
  Answer: 3 × 104
  3 × 104
  (Divide the numbers, subtract the indices.)

sections.title: Multiplication
sections.content:
Calculate, giving your answer in standard form.

(a) (3 × 10²) × (4 × 10³)
(b) (2 × 105) × (3 × 104)
(c) (5 × 10³) × (4 × 10²)
(d) (7 × 104) × (2 × 106)

sections.title: Addition and subtraction
sections.content:
Calculate, giving your answer in standard form.

(a) (4 × 10³) + (5 × 10³)
(b) (7 × 105) − (2 × 105)
(c) (6 × 104) + (8 × 10³)
(d) (3.5 × 106) − (4 × 105)

sections.title: Worded problems
sections.content:
Answer in standard form.

(a) Light travels 3 × 108 m/s. How far in 500 s?
(b) A virus is 2.5 × 10−7 m. 4000 in a line?
(c) Earth mass: 6 × 1024 kg. Moon: 7.3 × 1022 kg. Difference?
(d) Population 6.7 × 107 shares 2.01 × 1012 equally. Each?
(e) Area = (4 × 10³) × (2.5 × 10²). Find area.

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ When multiplying in standard form, add the powers of 10
✗ (3 × 10²) × (2 × 10³) = 6 × 106
✓ If A ≥ 10 after calculation, adjust by increasing the power
✗ You can add numbers in standard form by adding the A values regardless of power
✓ To divide in standard form, subtract the powers
